title: Fierce / billboard sequence
slide_intent: Match verbal energy with visual emphasis because a word’s typography can reinforce how it should be heard.
strategic_value: A large assertive adjective alongside stylized portraits can position Dropbox as a supporter of expressive work.
demonstration: A roadside billboard sequence places an oversized blue adjective on yellow between colorful portrait panels, with supporting copy and cars below.
practical_value: Compare the dominant word with its smaller supporting statement and adjacent faces.

content_islands.name: Headline panel
content_islands.spec: Use the yellow central panel for the oversized blue word and small supporting copy.

content_islands.name: Portrait neighbors
content_islands.spec: Keep the colorful portraits on either side.

content_islands.name: Road context
content_islands.spec: Retain the cars and billboard structure to show viewing scale.
